items.excerpt: Med OL-gull i langrenn kom ein storkjefta Einar Hedegart (25) til skiskyttaropninga. Men Johan-Olav Botn (27) slo hardt tilbake.

items.title: Kolstad slapp med skrekken mot tabelljumboen
items.excerpt: Kolstads håndballherrer måtte virkelig slite for seieren mot bunnlaget Sandnes i eliteserien. Det endte til slutt 28-26. Sandnes hadde tatt null poeng før søndagens hjemmekamp, men mot Kolstad kjempet de til siste slutt. Det endte med det tiende strake tapet. Først med bare litt over ett minutt igjen på klokken gikk Kolstad opp i 27-26. Kolstad-tal

items.title: Aston Villa beat Birmingham in WSL derby
items.excerpt: Mathilde Harviken scores the only goal as Aston Villa beat Birmingham City in their first Women's Super League derby since May 2022.

items.title: Struggling Charlton make WSL history after defeat at West Ham
items.excerpt: Charlton Athletic become the first team in Women's Super League history to lose their opening 10 matches of the season as Viviane Asseyi scores twice to guide West Ham United to victory.

items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.excerpt: The Ukrainian president says restrictions are still in place and making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

items.title: Ronaldinho, 46, makes comeback for Ravenna
items.excerpt: Brazil legend Ronaldinho makes his comeback aged 46 for Ravenna, playing the first half of their Italian third-tier derby against Forli.

items.title: Czechia: Scores protest against public media reform
items.excerpt: Hundreds of thousands of people attended the protest against the government's plan to abolish broadcasting fees. Critics say the nationalist coalition would like to secure control over the media.

items.title: Israeli drone filmed flying low outside homes in southern Lebanon
items.excerpt: Video shows an Israeli drone flying at low altitude over a residential area in southern Lebanon.
